name: us022-dry-run-full-preview
description: T022 [US2, contracts/run-state.md §3 row 2, S6]: reconcile a spec to completion, then reconcile it again unchanged with --dry-run. Even though the second run's inputs match what the first run just recorded, --dry-run must never consult the state document, so the preview still predicts the real run exactly — the second run's calls.log must NOT be empty.
